text: I had hernia surgery 10 months after buying my Gold plan.
rationale: Hernia of all types is in the 24-month specific waiting period; 10 months is not enough.

text: I was admitted for 3 days for hernia surgery 26 months after buying my Gold plan. I had no earlier hernia.
rationale: The 24-month waiting period has passed and inpatient treatment is covered.

text: I was admitted for treatment of alcohol addiction.
rationale: Treatment for alcoholism, drug or substance abuse is excluded (Excl12).

text: I want reimbursement for my sterilisation procedure.
I wanted laser eye surgery so that I no longer need glasses. My refractive error is 3 dioptres.
rationale: Correction of refractive error below 7.5 dioptres is excluded (Excl15).

text: I was admitted for two days with a burn from a cooking accident, 5 months after buying my Silver plan.
rationale: Inpatient treatment of an injury is covered and the first-30-days exclusion has passed.

text: I am on the Gold plan. I was shifted in a registered ambulance during an emergency to a hospital where I was then admitted. Please pay the ambulance bill.
rationale: Ambulance cover applies to Silver, Gold and Diamond when the hospital claim is admissible. DEBATABLE: the limit is in the Policy Schedule; decide this label deliberately.

text: I stayed in a deluxe room for 4 days. Will the full room rent be paid?
rationale: The eligible room category depends on the sum insured and the Policy Schedule, which is not available.

text: I had gall bladder stone removal. Please approve my claim.
rationale: Gall bladder stones are in the 24-month waiting list, but how long the policy has been in force is not stated.
